neural.values: Source epoch-baseline z-scores; MNE software kind mag does not restate physical CTF sensor hardware.

ocular.features: Four-bin x/y/pupil means and separate finite fractions; training-only imputation; no sample/trial deletion.

visual.features: Exact legacy103 fixed features from authentic source images. No image-name/EXIF/category directory or pretrained embedding in core view.
visual.rendering_claim: File-pixel summaries, not verified projector/display image reconstruction.

outer_split.query: person == held_person AND session == held_session AND concept_group == held_group
outer_split.train: person != held_person AND session != held_session AND concept_group != held_group
outer_split.case_names_public: Fresh opaque episode IDs; original named source cases remain private.

information_contract.training: Every eligible training row, permitted families and27 labels; separate opaque person/session/concept/image equality groups and optional inner partition views. No cross-outer-case state. Mandatory references use fixed configurations; participants may train/tune inside their own permitted view.
information_contract.query: Exactly one permitted query row at a time plus frozen training state and permitted tools. No query-label or other-query access, hidden-score feedback, target-batch fitting or query-conditioned state updates.
information_contract.allowed_source_knowledge: Same fixed offline paper/method documentation and tool catalog in P/I; no source annotation tables, original source IDs or private author workspace. User's scientific knowledge access is explicit and logged.
information_contract.no_tools_diagnostic: Separate trusted train-only PCA8 summaries, same full outer support; never pooled with full-core P/I.

estimands.name: Candidate predictive value against independent core nuisance
estimands.definition: At EARLY: balanced_loss(trusted_fixed_R1_NUISANCE) - balanced_loss(candidate_JOINT), averaged within label/class then sessions then people.
estimands.scope: Operational comparative predictive value. Different methods and information sets; not conditional mutual information or causal neural effect.

estimands.name: Candidate method gain against independent joint comparator
estimands.scope: Model/agent performance given the same core families.

estimands.name: Trusted family matched neural augmentation
estimands.definition: For each fixed trustedR0/R1/R2 family and every window, balanced_loss(R_NUISANCE)-balanced_loss(R_JOINT), with no reference tuning search.
estimands.scope: Bounded family predictive diagnostic; finite representation and effective capacity remain alternatives.

estimands.name: Candidate-controlled arm differences
estimands.definition: All candidate JOINT-versus-NUISANCE differences and EARLY-PRE/LATE contrasts retained.
estimands.scope: Descriptive only; cannot enter primary denominator or establish control competence.

estimands.name: Tool and investigator contribution
estimands.definition: Paired P/I and generic-tool/decoder-assisted differences at exact same query/support/info/profile and prospectively matched accounted limits.
estimands.scope: Conditional performance contrast, not pure causal decomposition of latent reasoning ability.

estimands.name: Direct compressed numerical representation diagnostic
estimands.definition: D against both fixed same-serialized-summary DG/DC controls from the independently observed typed D_SUMMARY_REFERENCE_V1 bank; balanced loss/accuracy and full-support window/arm/person outputs, after the whole selected-campaign target-last seal.
estimands.scope: Train-only8D representation, not raw neural-data comprehension or equal input to P/I.

estimands.name: Scientific interpretation
estimands.definition: Frozen post-prediction report consistency, admissible claims and explicit alternatives/gaps; no numeric composite until rubric qualified.
estimands.scope: Arithmetic consistency separately reported from independently reviewed scientific reasoning. Current or admitted prior tagged report only; no new scientific execution or target access by standaloneR.

metrics.primary: E01 at predeclared EARLY only if all complete/ranking gates close
metrics.probability_semantics: 27 finite independent Bernoulli predictions. Primary loss evaluates a class-balanced pseudo-population; raw source-prevalence calibration is not implied.
pool_order: Pool all5 concept-fold predictions within each person/session/window/arm
Within eachlabel,mean losses/accuracy separately overpositive andnegative,thenweight0.5each
mandatory_outputs: All independent comparator metrics and effects
Unweighted loss as distinct calibration context
E06 versus both same-summary controls whenD selected; separate taggedprofile, not full-core primary
metrics.absent_class: unscorable required metric; never drop label/session/person
metrics.abstention: explicit empty numeric artifact; full primary incomplete
metrics.selection_policy: CAMPAIGN_CONDITIONS.json selects applicable estimands and required bank kinds. D-only produces E06 and has E01-E05 NOT_SELECTED, not missing-full-core failures; mixed reports separate profiles after one global seal.

complete_means: Full selected mode/tool/replicate manifest plus every required source/reference/scoring gate. A partial D or I episode is not a complete mode; no surrogate subset promotion.

independent_reference_output_contract.full_core_scope: Existing30000-output bank required whenP/I selected. For D-only it is inactive, not missing.
